messages:
mia: quick experiment report from onboarding run for the compact-embed-6b-quant variant. ran targeted semantic probes across 3 buckets (short/medium/long) to surface any recall drops before wider benching.

devon: sweet, short rundown?

mia: setup: 6-bit asymmetric quant, per-channel calibration, no KV cache, batch=128, eval set=5k stratified (50% english, 30% multilingual, 20% domain-specific). used exact cosine for ground truth.

renee: metrics?

eval-bot: job 1750123456_mini-onboard started by mia  status: succeeded  artifacts: s3://redwood-evals/emb-onboard/1750123456/

mia: top-level numbers:
```
recall@1: 0.63
recall@5: 0.80
recall@10: 0.86
mean_reciprocal_rank: 0.54
silhouette_overall: 0.18
silhouette_medium_queries: 0.23
avg_qps: 85
p95_latency: 34ms
```

devon: recall@5 looks promising. any stratified breaks?

mia: small drop for multilingual bucket: recall@5=0.73 (baseline non-quantized=0.79). longtail (len>80 chars) also down ~0.04. short queries held steady.

renee: is the drop evenly across languages or concentrated?

mia: concentrated in low-resource languages (vi, id) and some domain jargon. seems like quant noise hurting rare token embeddings.

devon: can we toggle per-channel scaling or try symmetric quant to see if that helps these langs?

mia: yes planning a follow-up: symmetric + higher calib samples for low-resource tokens. queuing 50k run with per-lang recalibration.

renee: also compare L2 vs cosine recall for the quant model, some customers use L2 indexes.

mia: noted. will include both in next run.

eval-bot: follow-up job queued: 1750123499_stratified-50k (owner: mia)

devon: operational question: is warm-start (KV cache) likely to mask quality regressions on short sessions?

mia: it can. our quick check used no cache to avoid masking; separate warm-start latency tests later.

renee: proposal: keep quant variant behind internal flag, start small canary with non-critical routes once 50k pass. escalate if multilingual recall doesn't recover.

mia: agree. opening ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/EMB-5123 (draft plan + artifact links). pinging bench and localization for extra samples.

devon: thanks team. update when 50k finishes, I'll run cluster cohesion visualizations and UMAP snapshots. :eyes:
